Taipei.fallbackAssumption: Years without a dated round use 6.5 %, the middle of the 5 % to 8 % historical average stated by the Taipei housing centre (2025). Not interpolated: rounds differ too much.

New Taipei.fallbackAssumption: Years without a dated round use 11.5 %, the median of the 13 New Taipei rounds in the NGO list (no dates). Not interpolated.

Taipei.assumption: Household income per year below the city's 50th-percentile limit. Missing years interpolated; 2015 to 2017 take the 2018 value.

New Taipei.assumption: Household income per year below the city's 50th-percentile limit. 2015 to 2020 take the 2021 value; 2022 interpolated.

turnoverQuarters.assumption: Units let to new tenants from turnover each quarter = stock ÷ 24 (the 6-year maximum tenancy of general households).

Taipei.fallbackAssumption: Not used: every year 2015 to 2025 has an official value (2023 and 2024 are published together).

New Taipei.fallbackAssumption: Not used: every year 2015 to 2025 has an official value.

Taipei.assumption: NT$ per person per month. 2021, 2023 and 2024 interpolated.

New Taipei.assumption: NT$ per person per month. 2022 and 2025 derived from the published limits ÷ 3 (secondary); 2021, 2023 and 2024 interpolated.

rentSubsidy.incomeMultipleAssumption: The 20th-percentile household-income route of 2015 to 2018 is not modelled; only the per-person rule is used.

singleUnder40.assumption: The Character_File has no age; the Character is treated as under 40.

multipliers.assumption: Where several groups apply, the largest multiplier is used.

period.assumption: The real programme pays for the calendar year, back to the month of the application, and households apply again each year. The game pays from the quarter after the result for 4 quarters (12 months).
